home.title: KUMAKIKAI | iPhone & iPad Apps
home.description: KUMAKIKAI is the app development brand run by Yuya Nakamura. We design, develop and maintain iPhone and iPad apps, including Uni:Note and OtoMiru.

about.title: About | KUMAKIKAI - Yuya Nakamura
about.description: Meet Yuya Nakamura, Software Engineer / App Developer behind KUMAKIKAI, with experience in embedded, business and mobile systems. Explore the iPhone and iPad apps developed under KUMAKIKAI.

uni-note.title: Uni:Note | KUMAKIKAI
uni-note.description: Uni:Note by KUMAKIKAI is an iPad app for handwritten lecture notes, PDF annotations and AI practice sets. Write with Apple Pencil and organize notes by subject and folder.

oto-miru.title: OtoMiru | KUMAKIKAI
oto-miru.description: OtoMiru by KUMAKIKAI displays Japanese speech from TV and face-to-face conversations as large captions on iPhone and iPad, helping you read words that are difficult to hear.

giga-poke.title: GigaPoke | KUMAKIKAI
giga-poke.description: GigaPoke is KUMAKIKAI’s unofficial iPhone app for povo 2.0 reward codes. Save codes from email, sort them by expiry, copy them and check upcoming rewards in a widget.

nocca.title: Nocca | KUMAKIKAI
nocca.description: Nocca is an iPhone app in development at KUMAKIKAI. It lets people who find family contact overwhelming express needs with short words and icons, with replies when needed.

uni-note-pocket.title: Uni:Note Pocket | KUMAKIKAI
uni-note-pocket.description: Uni:Note Pocket by KUMAKIKAI imports Uni:Note backups for read-only review on iPhone. Browse handwritten notes, search note titles and revisit practice sets and sticky markers.

balance-calendar.title: Balance Calendar | KUMAKIKAI
balance-calendar.description: Balance Calendar is KUMAKIKAI’s iPhone app for recording income, expenses and gambling gains or losses. Tag positive and negative amounts and review daily, monthly and yearly totals.

smokeless.title: Smokeless | KUMAKIKAI
smokeless.description: Smokeless by KUMAKIKAI records smoked and avoided cigarettes with one tap on iPhone. Review daily, monthly and yearly history, charts and estimated spending based on your records.

signal.title: SIGNAL | KUMAKIKAI
signal.description: SIGNAL is KUMAKIKAI’s iPhone news feed for articles from note, Qiita, Zenn and other sources. Choose which feeds to follow and open original articles from their headlines.
